title: AI Agent Tokenized Stock OS
description: Non-custodial MCP for Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain (4663): quotes, plans, Morpho Earn.
summary: Non-custodial MCP for Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain (4663): quotes, plans, Morpho Earn.
offersHint: Non-custodial MCP for Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain (4663): quotes, plans, Morpho Earn. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://aatos.dev/mcp · Optional headers: x-api-key

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Pro/Team API key from on-chain checkout (optional for free tools)

headerDocs.name: x-api-key
headerDocs.description: Pro/Team API key from on-chain checkout (optional for free tools)

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_access_pricing
toolsPreview.description: List Free / Pro / Team pricing (ETH on-chain, no Stripe) and how agents pay for write tools.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_access_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Build on-chain ETH payment plan for Pro/Team. After user pays, call stocktoken_access_activate.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_access_activate
toolsPreview.description: After ETH payment to treasury is confirmed, verify and issue API key (shown once).

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_access_status
toolsPreview.description: Check paid access for current API key context or a wallet owner.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_list
toolsPreview.description: AI Agent Tokenized Stock OS: list canonical tokenized stocks (Robinhood Stock Tokens), ETFs, USDG, and WETH on Robinhood Chain ID 4663. Use for AI agents trading tokenized equities/RWAs. Do NOT use for US brokerage equities (use Robinhood Trading MCP). Only registry addresses are real tokenized stocks.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_get
toolsPreview.description: Get metadata for one canonical Stock Token or core asset by symbol (e.g. NVDA) or contract address on Robinhood Chain 4663. Use to verify a token is official before trading.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_price
toolsPreview.description: Read USD price and ERC-8056 uiMultiplier for a Robinhood Stock Token on chain 4663. Prefer this over generic price tools for Stock Tokens. Feed price already includes corporate-action multiplier when Chainlink is configured. Not for brokerage stock quotes.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_value_holdings
toolsPreview.description: Value a wallet's Stock Token / ETF / USDG balances on Robinhood Chain 4663. Use for portfolio analysis of onchain RWA holdings.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_policy_get
toolsPreview.description: Get current AI Agent Tokenized Stock OS agent policy (max notional, slippage, simulate-first, kill switch).

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_policy_set
toolsPreview.description: Update session policy guardrails for AI Agent Tokenized Stock OS.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_quote
toolsPreview.description: AI Agent Tokenized Stock OS multi-venue quote: Uniswap Trading API, then 0x RFQ (Stock Tokens), then Chainlink oracle-indicative. Chain 4663.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_simulate
toolsPreview.description: Simulate / pre-trade check for a tokenized stock swap on chain 4663: allowlist, policy, multi-venue quote integrity.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_execute_plan
toolsPreview.description: Build non-custodial tx plan (approve + swap) via best venue (Uniswap / 0x). Does NOT sign or broadcast. Chain 4663.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_session_create
toolsPreview.description: Create a durable agent session with scoped permissions (persisted to DATA_DIR). Non-custodial.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_session_kill
toolsPreview.description: Kill an agent session immediately (kill switch).

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_session_list
toolsPreview.description: List agent sessions, optionally filtered by owner.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_session_update
toolsPreview.description: Update limits/permissions on an existing session.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_protocols
toolsPreview.description: Return Uniswap Universal Router, PoolManager, WETH, USDG, and feed source metadata for Robinhood Chain 4663.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_fees
toolsPreview.description: Summarize disclosed AATOS execution fee events and on-chain monetization status (treasury / ETH fees).

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_subscription_tiers
toolsPreview.description: List AATOS on-chain subscription tiers (paid in ETH to treasury). No Stripe.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_subscribe_plan
toolsPreview.description: Build non-custodial ETH subscription plan (tier pro|team, or custom ethAmount). Pays treasury on chain 4663.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_subscription_status
toolsPreview.description: Check on-chain subscription status for a wallet (requires SUBSCRIPTION_REGISTRY_ADDRESS when deployed).

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_tip_presets
toolsPreview.description: List optional tip presets (ETH) and what assets the tip wallet accepts (ETH, any ERC-20 on 4663, optional native BTC). Tips never required.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_tip_assets
toolsPreview.description: What the AATOS tip wallet can accept: native ETH + any ERC-20 on Robinhood Chain 4663; optional native BTC address if configured.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_tip_plan
toolsPreview.description: Build OPTIONAL tip plan. asset=ETH (default) | BTC | registry symbol (USDG,WETH,NVDA,…) | 0x token. amount or ETH preset. User must confirm. Never coerce.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_metrics
toolsPreview.description: Operational metrics for this AI Agent Tokenized Stock OS process.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_morpho_status
toolsPreview.description: Morpho / Robinhood Earn status on chain 4663: Steakhouse USDG vault address, live TVL, share price.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_morpho_position
toolsPreview.description: Read a wallet's Morpho Earn (steakUSDG) share balance and underlying USDG on chain 4663.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_morpho_deposit_plan
toolsPreview.description: Build non-custodial ERC-4626 deposit plan (approve USDG + deposit) into Morpho Steakhouse Earn vault. Does NOT broadcast.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_morpho_withdraw_plan
toolsPreview.description: Build non-custodial Morpho Earn withdraw (by USDG) or redeem (by shares) plan. Does NOT broadcast.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_intent_typed_data
toolsPreview.description: Build EIP-712 typed data for an agent trade intent (offchain authorization standard). User/wallet signs; onchain verifier later.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_basket_preview
toolsPreview.description: Preview AI mega-cap basket constituents and live Chainlink prices (vault scaffold preview).

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_permit2_prepare
toolsPreview.description: Prepare Permit2 approve + optional typed data for Uniswap-style flows on chain 4663.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_liquidity_matrix
toolsPreview.description: Liquidity / V3-executable route matrix for major USDG pairs on chain 4663. Use to know which Stock Tokens have live AMM fills.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_find_pools
toolsPreview.description: Scan for Uniswap V3 pools between two tokens on chain 4663. Useful when APIs block Stock Tokens.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_system_status
toolsPreview.description: Full system status: secrets, venues, chain, version, session count, fees.

toolsPreview.name: stocktoken_explain_routing
toolsPreview.description: Explain when to use AI Agent Tokenized Stock OS vs Robinhood official Agentic Trading MCP vs raw Uniswap/0x.
